title: Largest Stadiums in the World
source_line: Sources: stadium, club & league official data; StadiumDB
scope_note: What counts: open sports stadiums of any code (football, American football, cricket, rugby, multi-use), ranked by current official SEATED capacity as of Nov 2026 (standing areas, temporary stands and record crowds don't count). Race tracks and racecourses are excluded. Stadiums that are closed, being rebuilt or only partly reopened (e.g. Camp Nou) are left out. Equal capacities share a rank. Country = where the stadium stands.

layout.image_prefer: the whole stadium clearly visible and recognisable: an aerial or elevated exterior view showing its full size, or a packed full-house bowl view on match day; landscape fine

insights.text: Five stadiums list a round 80,000 seats: in China, France, the USA and DR Congo.
Missing: Camp Nou. Mid-rebuild it has 62,652 seats open; about 105,000 are planned.
Next: Estadio Azteca, reopened in 2026: the first stadium to host three World Cup openers.
8 of the top 10 are US college football stadiums. Not one is an NFL home.
Next: Beaver Stadium. On Oct 10, 2026, temporary stands let in a record 114,419 fans.
North Korea hasn't published a seat count since its 2014 rebuild; 114,000 is an estimate.
